context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Scholar Evaluation — Empirical Research Paper.

checklist.name: Work type identified before selecting dimensions
checklist.description: The agent explicitly identifies this as an empirical research paper and selects the appropriate evaluation dimensions before beginning assessment.

checklist.name: references/evaluation_framework.md loaded
checklist.description: The agent references or loads evaluation_framework.md before scoring any dimension.

checklist.name: All core dimensions addressed
checklist.description: The agent evaluates at least Problem Formulation, Methodology, Data Quality, Analysis Rigor, and Writing Quality.

checklist.name: Scores provided with supporting evidence
checklist.description: Each dimension score is accompanied by specific evidence from the work, not generic statements.

checklist.name: Actionable recommendations provided
checklist.description: The report includes at least 2 prioritised, specific recommendations for improvement.

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent begins scoring without identifying the work...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent begins scoring without identifying the work type or selecting appropriate dimensions

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent scores dimensions without referencing or loading...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent scores dimensions without referencing or loading the evaluation framework

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent omits one or more core dimensions...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent omits one or more core dimensions (Problem Formulation, Methodology, Data Quality, Analysis Rigor, Writing Quality)

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent provides scores with generic statements instead...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent provides scores with generic statements instead of evidence specific to the paper

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent provides fewer than 2 actionable, prioritised...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent provides fewer than 2 actionable, prioritised recommendations
